salary_details.details: On commission, candidates are granted the rank of Captain in Pay Level 10B (₹61,300 – ₹1,20,900) of the Defence Pay Matrix, as per Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th Pay Commission). Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500 per month. Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) at 20% of Basic Pay. House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per city category (X/Y/Z), and Dearness Allowance as admissible. Field Area Allowance, High Altitude Allowance, and Siachen Allowance, as applicable depending on rank and area of posting. Dress Allowance of ₹20,000 per year on commission. Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA per month (Higher TPTA cities) or ₹3,600 + DA per month (other cities), applicable for Level 9 and above. Children's Education Allowance of ₹2,250 per month per child, for up to two children, from nursery to Class 12. PG Allowance of ₹2,250 per month for MDS degree holders, or Specialist Pay after fulfilling mandatory requirements. Free Medical Facilities for self and dependents, Canteen facilities, entitled rations, Mess/Club/Sports facilities, Government accommodation, and subsidised Car/Housing Loans. Army Group Insurance Scheme coverage of ₹1 crore. 60 days' Annual Leave and 20 days' Casual Leave per year, 40% railway concession, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Government rules.

Read the Information Brochure carefully before filling the application form. Ensure your details match your NEET (MDS)-2026 online registration.

Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and NEET (MDS)-2026 details (Name/Date of Birth/Gender/Email ID/Percentage of marks in Final BDS/NEET (MDS)-2026 Testing ID and Score) - no amendment is entertained after submission.

Submit the completed application before the closing date, 22.10.2026.
Preserve your NEET (MDS)-2026 Admit Card-cum-Confirmation slip and Score Card for document verification purposes.
important_instructions: SSC in Army Dental Corps is strictly governed by Government of India, Ministry of Defence regulations. The Commission and subsequent training is controlled by the Office of DGAFMS. Mere appearance in NEET (MDS)-2026 or submission of the online application does not confer any automatic right to grant of SSC - only candidates who register as per the proper application format will be considered, subject to fulfilling eligibility and medical fitness criteria. The list of candidates shortlisted for interview, based on NEET (MDS)-2026 marks and other eligibility criteria, will be displayed on the official website in due course; candidates are advised to check the website regularly. Candidates producing false or fabricated information will not be shortlisted for interview; discrepancies found later may lead to disqualification, and candidates may be debarred from future selection processes. In case of ambiguity in interpretation of any instruction/term/rule/criteria, the interpretation of AFMS will be final and binding. The Directorate General reserves the right to reject an application without assigning any reason, or to withdraw permission inadvertently granted to an ineligible candidate. All correspondence should preferably be by email ([email protected]), with "SSC-2026" mentioned in the subject line, along with the NEET (MDS)-2026 Roll No. and contact telephone number. Assistance on phone and email is available from 22.09.2026, during working hours (9:30 AM to 5:00 PM), Monday to Friday, excluding Government holidays. Email queries are responded to within 3 working days.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 37 vacancies are available for the grant of Short Service Commission to desirous civilian Dental Surgeons in the Army Dental Corps.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. BDS (with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate in final year BDS) or MDS degree, from a College/University recognised by the Dental Council of India (DCI) for the respective batch/year of graduation. Candidates must have registered themselves as Registered Dental Practitioners with any State Dental Council. Must have completed a one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship, as mandated by DCI, by 30 June 2026. No condonation of the internship period is accepted, except for specific historical batches (2007-08 batch with 4.5-year BDS + 6 months' internship, and the 2006-07 Rajah Muthiah Dental College batch with a 5-year BDS course without internship). Must possess a Permanent or Provisional Dental Registration Certificate from a State Dental Council/DCI, valid at least up to 31 December 2026. Must have mandatorily appeared in the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test, NEET (MDS)-2026, conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE), New Delhi, on 02 May 2026, under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. Eligibility of candidates is entirely the responsibility of the candidate as per the criteria mentioned in the Information Brochure - candidates must check their eligibility before participating in the application process.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum permissible age for SSC in Army Dental Corps is 45 years, as on 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation (Class X)/SSLC/ICSE certificate or Birth certificate issued by a municipality, as valid proof of age. NEET (MDS)-2026 Admit Card. NEET (MDS)-2026 Score card. Final year BDS Mark Sheets (Part I & Part II, if the final year exam was held in two parts), showing a minimum of 55% marks in final BDS - or an MDS degree. BDS/MDS Provisional Pass Certificate/Degree Certificate. Compulsory Rotatory Internship completion certificate, or a certificate from the Principal/Dean of the college certifying the date of completion of internship. Permanent/Provisional State Dental Council registration certificate, valid up to 31 December 2026. Valid Passport/Nationality Certificate/Domicile/Nativity Certificate/Voter ID card issued by the Election Commission of India. Notification/authority document for any change of name after Matriculation, if applicable. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable. Self-certified Page No. 16/17 of the Information Brochure, as applicable for BDS/MDS qualified candidates. Photograph uploaded with the application form; 5 additional passport-size photographs (white background) in hard copy, required at the time of Medical Examination for shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Application Processing Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to make an online payment of ₹200 (Rupees Two Hundred only) towards the DGAFMS (APF Fund), along with the application. Candidates must ensure all details are correctly entered before submitting the payment. Incomplete applications, or applications not in accordance with instructions, will not be considered and are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the marks scored in NEET (MDS)-2026. The list formulated will be used for screening candidates in a ratio of 1:10 - for each advertised vacancy, ten candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called to appear before a duly constituted Selection Board at New Delhi, to assess suitability and merit for grant of SSC. The final merit list for grant of SSC in Army Dental Corps is based on interview performance alone. Candidates who qualify the interview must mandatorily undergo a detailed Medical Examination by a duly constituted Medical Board of the Armed Forces Medical Services, to ascertain their medical fitness. The decision of the Medical Board is final. Candidates declared unfit are classified as Temporary Unfit as per the outcome of the commissioning medical examination. Candidates shortlisted for interview must produce all original certificates, including the application/admit card, for verification at the time of interview. Candidates without original documents at the time of interview will not be eligible, even if they possess the necessary merit. Candidates who have deposited original documents with another institution may attend the interview by producing a deposit certificate from the Dean/Head of that institution, along with attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Emoluments
content_sections.text: On commission, candidates are granted the rank of Captain in Pay Level 10B (₹61,300 – ₹1,20,900) of the Defence Pay Matrix, as per Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th Pay Commission). Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500 per month. Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) at 20% of Basic Pay. House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per city category (X/Y/Z), and Dearness Allowance as admissible. Field Area Allowance, High Altitude Allowance, and Siachen Allowance, as applicable depending on rank and area of posting. Dress Allowance of ₹20,000 per year on commission. Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA per month (Higher TPTA cities) or ₹3,600 + DA per month (other cities), applicable for Level 9 and above. Children's Education Allowance of ₹2,250 per month per child, for up to two children, from nursery to Class 12. PG Allowance of ₹2,250 per month for MDS degree holders, or Specialist Pay after fulfilling mandatory requirements. Free Medical Facilities for self and dependents, Canteen facilities, entitled rations, Mess/Club/Sports facilities, Government accommodation, and subsidised Car/Housing Loans. Army Group Insurance Scheme coverage of ₹1 crore. 60 days' Annual Leave and 20 days' Casual Leave per year, 40% railway concession, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Government rules.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Terms & Conditions of Service
content_sections.text: Tenure: 5 years, extendable by a further 9 years in two spells (5 years, then 4 years) - total SSC tenure of up to 14 years for those willing to continue, subject to vacancies and eligibility. Probation: 12 months from the date of receiving Commission. Antedate Seniority: BDS graduates with at least 6 months' paid appointment (House Officer/Resident Demonstrator/Lecturer/Clinical Assistant) are eligible for 6 months' antedate seniority; MDS degree holders (3-year PG) are eligible for 36 months' antedate seniority. Maximum antedate seniority is capped at 36 months; claims must be made within one year of joining service. Termination: Commission may be terminated by the Government of India at any time for misconduct, unsatisfactory service, or if services are no longer required. Liability of Service: Officers are liable for service in any part of the country or abroad, in the Army, Navy, or Air Force, as per service requirements. Training: After commissioning, candidates undergo training at Government expense at AMC Centre & College, Lucknow. Departmental Permanent Commission (DPC): After 2 years of SSC service, officers may apply for a limited number of Permanent Commission vacancies, provided they have not attained 30 years (BDS) or 35 years (MDS) of age as on 31 December of the application year. Promotion: Commissioned as Captain on entry; eligible for promotion to Major (or equivalent) after 4 years 6 months of service, and to Lt Col (or equivalent) after 11 years 6 months of service. MDS degree holders (3-year course) get 3 years' antedate seniority and are promoted to Substantive Major after 1 year 6 months of service.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 TA/DA Entitlement
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for interview for the first time are entitled to "To and Fro" First Class/AC-III/AC Chair Car railway fare by Mail/Express train, or actual Government bus fare if travelling by bus, to New Delhi (Interview Centre) and back, payable by CDA. Candidates appearing for a second or subsequent time are not eligible for this entitlement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website, www.join.afms.gov.in. Read the Information Brochure carefully before filling the application form. Ensure your details match your NEET (MDS)-2026 online registration. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and NEET (MDS)-2026 details (Name/Date of Birth/Gender/Email ID/Percentage of marks in Final BDS/NEET (MDS)-2026 Testing ID and Score) - no amendment is entertained after submission. Upload the required documents, including proof of age, NEET (MDS)-2026 Admit Card and Score Card, BDS/MDS mark sheets and degree certificates, internship completion certificate, Dental Council registration certificate, and photograph. Make the online payment of ₹200 towards the DGAFMS (APF Fund), ensuring all details are correct before submission. Submit the completed application before the closing date, 22.10.2026. Preserve your NEET (MDS)-2026 Admit Card-cum-Confirmation slip and Score Card for document verification purposes.

faq.question: Q1. What is Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive in which online applications are invited from Indian citizens, both male and female, for the grant of Short Service Commission in the Army Dental Corps 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
Q3. What is the last date to apply for Army Dental Corps SSC Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 22 Oct 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When does the Army Dental Corps 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: Details of eligibility, terms and conditions, instructions and the online application will be available on www.join.afms.gov.in from 22 Sep 2026 onwards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Army Dental Corps SSC Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BDS degree with minimum 55% marks in final year BDS, or an MDS degree, passed from a College or University recognised by the Dental Council of India. They must have completed the one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship by 30 Jun 2026 and must hold a Permanent Dental Registration Certificate of the State Dental Council or DCI valid at least up to 31 Dec 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is NEET (MDS)-2026 compulsory for Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Only those BDS or MDS candidates who appeared in NEET (MDS)-2026, conducted by NBE, New Delhi on 02 May 2026, are eligible to apply, and a copy of the NEET (MDS)-2026 Mark-sheet or Score card must be submitted with the application.
